name: Source-system operational population export

patterns_used: Separate source populations by originating module and retain system-like field order.
Vary row density by population instead of normalizing every sheet.
foundation_lineage.transformation_boundary: Reuse only source-owned field order and population-density principles; generate every row, code, identifier, date, and value from the new authorized world.

producer: Operational source system under a named business owner
purpose: Export a complete in-scope operational population for reconciliation, filtering, exception review, or downstream analysis.
medium: UTF-8 delimited source-system export with stable machine fields
lifecycle: Point-in-time system extraction retained with its query boundary

authority.governing_scope: Represents system-of-record values for the documented extract scope and time.
authority.non_governing_scope: Does not prove off-system events, later changes, or analyst conclusions.

authorized_inputs: Documented extract filters, field dictionary, and as-of time
excluded_inputs: Analyst formatting and conclusions inside the export
source_boundary.conflict_resolution: The documented extract query defines population scope; downstream exceptions do not rewrite source rows.

footprint.target: Population-dependent rows with stable source fields
natural_depth: Repeated identifiers, statuses, codes, dates, nulls, and timestamps
Active, inactive, ordinary, and exceptional records within scope
Stable field order and machine serialization
footprint.source_owned_rationale: Row count and sparsity come from the complete query result and system data model, not a target designed for evaluator difficulty.

sequence: System executes query at recorded time

proof_gates.procedure: Verify schema, encoding, delimiters, row count, identifiers, and query boundary.
Render a bounded tabular preview and inspect headers and representative records.
Inspect filename, encoding, line endings, delimiters, timestamps, and sidecar manifest.
Confirm the source export contains values rather than executable formulas.
proof_gates.not_applicable_rationale: The CSV is a source population; downstream work owns computations.

proof_gates.procedure: Trace field definitions, query scope, and population counts to the approved source manifest.
Scan all fields and rows for prior-world, generator, and evaluation residue.
Separate source values from downstream interpretation and governing approvals.
Prove every row belongs to the documented complete extract population.
